name: rung1_capture_delays
status: TEMPLATE (refused by eval/bin2fgo.py load_delays). Filled from the VERIFICATION logs (B, H, V) by the procedure in docs/rung1_preregistration.md sec. 6, then set to PRE-REGISTERED and committed, with its sha256 recorded in a METHODOLOGY entry, BEFORE any result flight is scored.
method: eval/sensor_timing_from_log.py <commit>: flow = the per-axis rule on the sync wiggles / bench rotations; range = truth-height method on the climbs and descents against mocap (mocap_align TUM on the FC clock)

definition.flow: FC arrival (OF.TimeUS) minus the END of the flow integration interval
definition.range: emission (RRNI change frame, held at the measured update period) minus measurement
definition.imu: RFRH frame time minus the end of the RISI delta interval (0: the IMU is the time base)

notes: One file per vehicle and sensor set; a sensor change needs a new file measured on new verification logs.
